## 改了什么、为什么 / What and why

关联 Issue / Related issue: #

## 怎么测的 / How was it tested

- [ ] 全部测试通过、零警告 / All tests pass with zero warnings（`xcodebuild test`）
- 新增或修改的测试 / Tests added or changed：
- 真机手测步骤 / Manual steps on a real Mac：
- [ ] 改动了界面：附截图，并有"真实界面"级测试 / UI change: screenshots attached and covered by a real-interface test
- [ ] 改动了翻译链路：用真实模型跑通过 / Touches the translation pipeline: exercised against a real model

没做到的项请写明原因 / If anything above wasn't done, explain why:

## 自查 / Checklist

- [ ] 没有 API Key、证书或真实个人数据进仓库 / No API keys, certificates or real personal data committed
- [ ] 没有新增系统权限或 entitlement / No new system permissions or entitlements
- [ ] 使用了 AI 编码助手的话注明是哪个 / If an AI assistant was used, name it here：
